newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC says Q1 1997 loan loss provisions flat.
newsitem.headline: CIBC says Q1 1997 loan loss provisions flat.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday that it expects loan loss provisions for the first quarter of 1997 to remain at C$120 million, unchanged from the first quarter a year earlier.
The bank said it also expects annual loan loss provisions for the full 1997 year to be unchanged at C$480 million from 1996.

CIBC said its impaired loans fell sharply to 0.4 percent of total loans at C$568 million in the first quarter of 1997 ended January 31 from 0.9 percent of total loans or C$1.085 billion in the first quarter of 1996.
